name: Can I replace my kitchen countertops without replacing the cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my kitchen countertops without replacing the cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can keep your existing cabinets if they are structurally sound, level, and capable of bearing the heavy weight of stone. Heavy materials like granite, quartz, and marble require solid cabinet boxes without sagging or water damage. Before ordering countertops, we inspect your base cabinets, face frames, and leveling. If adjustments, reinforcement, or leveling shims are needed, our finish carpentry crew can repair and prep the existing cabinetry before stone templating to prevent cracking or uneven seams.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, provided your existing cabinets are structurally sound and level. We inspect the boxes and can reinforce or level them using our finish carpentry team before stone installation.
